title: Glif
content:
What does it mean to have a genuine point of view in the age of AI? The models, yes, can be extraordinary. Yet it often seems like something else is broken or missing. Creating can mean bouncing between a dozen tools, managing prompts across tabs, and sometimes losing the thread of a creative vision. In an era of tool proliferation, what remains scarce are tools that truly understand and empower creatives.

That’s what Glif is: the creative expertise layer for AI.

Glif v1 enabled millions of creators to build hundreds of thousands of AI workflows where they figured out, through trial and error, which models to chain together for which creative tasks including image sequencing, video, audio, music and more. Through hundreds of millions of runs, the Glif community figured out what processes work: the model pairings, the right prompt strategies, the right sequences to turn an idea into a finished thing. All of that accumulated creative process knowledge is the magic that now lives inside Glif.

Glif v2 distills everything learned from this community into one single creative orchestration agent. You describe what you want to make and Glif handles the rest by selecting the right models, applying the learned techniques and handling the production pipeline. It can do this, seamlessly and in real time, because it learned from watching millions of people create.

The creative output – the images, sounds, graphics – are your own. Glif speed runs your path. You get to be more creative, as Glif does the heavy lifting of everything else taking up your brain space.

The more you use Glif, the better a creative partner it becomes. It learns your aesthetic, your processes, your distinct judgment. And it compounds. Your Glif becomes a partner that understands uniquely how you work. And every user’s creative practice feeds right back into the system, making the whole thing smarter. Glif is the specialist trained on data, yes; but more importantly it’s trained on the creative production workflows of a massive community of makers. Real creators doing real work.

Fabian and Jamie are long-experienced hackers, engineers, entrepreneurs, graphic designers and filmmakers. They’ve spent careers as makers themselves. We’re thrilled to continue to partner with them as they infuse their hard earned expertise into a tool to ease the path for millions of passionate users lucky to benefit from their perspective, taste and creative energy.
